outcome: E2 levels on HCG test day
cohort: Patients who underwent in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer at a reproductive medicine center in China between February 2013 and March 2021, including those with and without PCOS, giving birth to single fetuses.
finding: Frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) may increase the incidence of low placenta, fetal distress, and neonatal jaundice, while PCOS disease itself had no significant effect on perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The natural birth rate was lower and the cesarean section rate was higher in the FET-non-PCOS group compared to fresh embryo transfer (ET) groups (PCOS and non-PCOS).
birth_weight: Measured (no significant difference found between groups)
gest_age: Measured (no significant difference found between groups)
